literal_meaning: ছোট (small) + মোট (total/all, in reduplicative form indicating various small things)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছোটমোট সমস্যা নিয়ে বেশি চিন্তা করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't worry too much about petty problems.
note: Synonymous with 'ছোটখাটো'; often used in colloquial Bengali to downplay importance.
